topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 37 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens, 7 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, dsauth). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
